articles.title: Incêndio em Manacapuru: fogo ameaça casas e plantações no Amazonas | G1
articles.standfirst: A ocorrência foi registrada no quilômetro 17 da rodovia AM-352, nas proximidades do Ramal da Família e da comunidade Nova Conquista.
articles.summary: O incêndio em Manacapuru atinge a rodovia AM-352 e comunidades rurais, gerando fumaça tóxica e mobilizando moradores que aguardam a chegada dos bombeiros.
articles.body:
Moradores pedem ajuda para combater incêndio que ameaça casas e plantações em Manacapuru, no AM. — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

Moradores de comunidades localizadas em uma área próxima à mata, em Manacapuru , no interior do Amazonas, pediram ajuda para combater um incêndio que avançou durante a noite e a madrugada desta segunda-feira (7). Segundo os relatos, as chamas se aproximaram de casas e plantações, causando medo entre as famílias.

A ocorrência foi registrada no quilômetro 17 da rodovia AM-352, nas proximidades do Ramal da Família e da comunidade Nova Conquista.

Em um vídeo divulgado pelos moradores, uma mulher faz um apelo por ajuda da Defesa Civil, do Corpo de Bombeiros e da Prefeitura de Manacapuru. Segundo ela, o fogo chegou a ficar a cerca de 100 metros de algumas residências.

“Nós precisamos de ajuda, pessoal. Quem puder, nos ajude. Estamos fazendo esse vídeo pedindo apoio da Defesa Civil, do Corpo de Bombeiros, da Prefeitura de Manacapuru, carro-pipa. Pelo amor de Deus, o fogo está muito próximo, nossas casas estão correndo risco”, disse a moradora.

De acordo com os relatos, o incêndio atingiu uma área de vegetação localizada atrás das residências e avançou durante a noite. Além da ameaça às casas, moradores também temem prejuízos às plantações e o agravamento da qualidade do ar na região.

Ainda não havia, até a manhã desta segunda-feira, informações oficiais sobre o controle total das chamas. Segundo informações apuradas no local, moradores e outras pessoas da região tentaram conter o fogo durante a noite.

O g1 solicitou informações do Corpo de Bombeiros para saber se foram acionados para combater as chamas, mas não obteve retorno até a publicação desta reportagem.

A fumaça provocada pelas queimadas também tem afetado a qualidade do ar em Manacapuru e municípios próximos.

Dados consultados durante a manhã apontavam registros de focos de calor entre Manacapuru e Novo Airão. Na região do quilômetro 17 da AM-352, ainda havia indicação de dois focos.

Em Manacapuru, a concentração de partículas no ar chegou a 192 microgramas por metro cúbico durante a manhã, índice considerado muito ruim. Em Novo Airão, o registro foi de 65,8 microgramas por metro cúbico, também indicando condições desfavoráveis para a qualidade do ar.

O caso segue sendo acompanhado, e moradores aguardam a chegada de equipes para ajudar no combate às chamas e evitar que o incêndio atinja as residências.

articles.title: 7 de Setembro: veja as mudanças no trânsito para o desfile cívico em São Luís | G1
articles.standfirst: Ponte do São Francisco fica interditada durante a programação, marcada para começar às 8h. A Ponte Bandeira Tribuzzi será uma das rotas alternativas.
articles.summary: Ponte do São Francisco fica interditada durante a programação, marcada para começar às 8h. A Ponte Bandeira Tribuzzi será uma das rotas alternativas.
articles.body:
O trânsito na Avenida Beira-Mar e em outras vias do Centro de São Luís tem alterações nesta segunda-feira (7) por causa do desfile cívico-militar de 7 de Setembro. A programação começa às 8h, e o desfile está previsto para as 9h.

A Ponte Governador José Sarney, conhecida como Ponte do São Francisco, está interditada durante o evento. Com o bloqueio, motoristas que seguem para o Centro devem usar a Ponte Bandeira Tribuzzi como rota alternativa ( veja mais detalhes abaixo ).

Veja as mudanças no trânsito para o desfile de 7 de Setembro em São Luís — Foto: Divulgação/SMTT

O acesso da Ponte Bandeira Tribuzi à Avenida Beira-Mar também está fechado. Por isso, passageiros de carros por aplicativo devem desembarcar antes do bloqueio e seguir parte do trajeto a pé.

Ruas que dão acesso à Avenida Beira-Mar também estão bloqueadas. Agentes da Secretaria Municipal de Trânsito e Transportes (SMTT) e das forças de segurança orientam os motoristas na região.

A programação começa às 8h, com o hasteamento da Bandeira Nacional e a presença de autoridades. Às 8h30, está prevista a revista da tropa.

O desfile terá a participação de forças federais, estaduais e municipais, além de entidades civis e estudantes de escolas militares e das redes estadual e municipal de ensino.

Este é o segundo ano consecutivo em que o desfile ocorre na Avenida Beira-Mar. A organização orienta o público a chegar com antecedência e ficar atento aos bloqueios. Os trechos interditados estão sinalizados com cones.

articles.title: Pirarucu de quase 2m é encontrado morto no CE com roupa presa na boca | G1
articles.standfirst: Animal, que estava na lagoa de Aquiraz desde de 2010, será empalhado e usado em ações de conscientização ambiental.
articles.summary: Animal estava desde 2010 na lagoa de Aquiraz e será usado em ações de conscientização ambiental.
articles.body:
Um peixe da espécie pirarucu, de aproximadamente 1,87 metro de comprimento e cerca de 99 quilos , foi encontrado morto em uma lagoa na cidade de Aquiraz , na Região Metropolitana de Fortaleza , na tarde do último sábado (5).

No momento do resgate do animal, os membros da Associação de Preservação do Meio Ambiente, Patrimonio Histórico, Educacional e Difusão da Cultura de Aquiraz (Apremace) constataram que uma peça de roupa, semelhante a uma canga de crochê, estava presa na boca do peixe .

Uma das suspeitas dos ambientalistas é que o pirarucu possa ter confundido o material com alimento e tentado ingeri-lo, situação que pode ter contribuído para sua morte.

"O episódio reforça um grave problema que ameaça diariamente a fauna aquática: o descarte inadequado de lixo, roupas, plásticos e outros materiais em lagoas, açudes, rios, praias e demais ambientes naturais", disse a Apremace.

Animal estava há 16 anos no reservatório

Uma das suspeitas do ambientalistas é que o pirarucu possa ter confundido a peça de roupa com alimento e tentado ingeri-la. — Foto: Apremace/ Arquivo pessoal

Segundo a Apremace, o pirarucu encontrado morto havia sido introduzido na lagoa em 2010 , durante as comemorações da Semana do Meio Ambiente, período que também marcou a criação da Secretaria Municipal de Meio Ambiente e Desenvolvimento Urbano (SEMAD) de Aquiraz.

"Ao longo dos anos, o peixe tornou-se parte da memória ambiental do município", disse a entidade ambiental.

Como forma de preservar sua memória e contribuir para ações de educação ambiental, o peixe será submetido a processo de taxidermia, popularmente conhecida como empalhamento.

Posteriormente, o pirarucu ficará disponível para observação na sede da Apremace, onde poderá ser utilizado em atividades educativas e de conscientização.

Peixe será empalhado e ficará na Associação de Preservação do Meio Ambiente de Aquiraz, para ser usado em ações de conscientização ambiental. — Foto: Apremace/ Arquivo pessoal

articles.title: Vazamento de água abre cratera e alaga rua no Barreiro, em BH | G1
articles.standfirst: Água jorrou do chão durante a madrugada e chegou à Avenida Olinto Meireles, no bairro Milionários, Região do Barreiro; máquinas e equipes da Copasa trabalham no local nesta segunda-feira (7).
articles.summary: Água jorrou do chão durante a madrugada e chegou à Avenida Olinto Meireles, no bairro Milionários, Região do Barreiro; máquinas e equipes da Copasa trabalham no local nesta segunda
articles.body:
Um grande vazamento de água alagou a Rua Caetano Pirri, no bairro Milionários, na Região do Barreiro, em Belo Horizonte , na madrugada desta segunda-feira (7). A força da água abriu uma cratera no local e provocou alagamentos também na Avenida Olinto Meireles.

Vídeos mostram o momento em que a água jorra com muita força do chão e toma conta da via. Nas imagens, é possível ver o grande volume de água chegando à avenida e dificultando a circulação pelo trecho ( veja vídeo acima ).

Na manhã desta segunda, máquinas e funcionários da Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais (Copasa) estavam no local para realizar os trabalhos de reparo.

A Copasa informou que equipes operacionais e de engenharia da companhia já estão no local para realizar os trabalhos de manutenção e os diagnósticos necessários.

Segundo a empresa, o andamento dos serviços está sendo acompanhado e um boletim será divulgado com a atualização do cronograma de reparo e a previsão de normalização do abastecimento de água.

articles.title: Amigas descobrem que moram perto após se reencontrarem  | G1
articles.standfirst: A médica Isabela Machado e a professora de inglês Gabriela Arantes retomaram o contato depois de mais de 25 anos, quando Isabela viu as fotos e lembranças da amiga durante os preparativos para o casamento.
articles.summary: Após 25 anos, o reencontro de amigas após post viral revelou que Isabela Machado e Gabriela Arantes moram em cidades vizinhas em Goiás e já planejam um encontro presencial.
articles.body:
A médica Isabela Machado e a professora de inglês Gabriela Arantes, que se reencontraram após o post viralizar , moram em cidades vizinhas na região Metropolitana de Goiânia , capital deGoiás. “Nós duas somos de Goiânia. Eu me mudei para Palmas e ela se mudou para Florianópolis. Hoje moro em Goiânia e ela mora em Nerópolis , eu acho”, contou Isabela. As duas retomaram o contato depois de mais de 25 anos, quando Isabela viu as fotos e lembranças da amiga durante os preparativos para o casamento.

Isabela contou que, ao ver as fotos de infância para montar um painel “túnel do tempo” em seu casamento, percebeu que o noivo mantinha contato com as amizades do jardim de infância. “Vi minhas fotos com a Gabi na escola e fiquei muito triste por não tê-la por perto também”, declarou.

Foi então que a médica decidiu postar nas redes sociais as fotos com Gabriela para encontrar a amiga. Segundo Isabela, uma amiga de uma amiga dela reconheceu Gabriela em menos de 24 horas depois das fotos serem postadas. “Ela viu e entrou em contato por DM, trocamos telefones e estamos marcando um encontro para daqui uns dias”, relatou.

Isabela Machado e Gabriela Arantes aparecem juntas em registros da infância, em Goiânia — Foto: Reprodução/Instagram de Isabela Machado

No post que chegou à amiga de uma amiga de Gabriela, Isabela mostrava fotos e contava a história de como era a amizade das duas e como se separaram ainda na infância ( veja acima ). A médica contou que as duas fizeram poucos anos do jardim de infância juntas e, aos sete anos de idade, a médica se mudou de cidade, mas sempre encontrava a amiga quando viajava para Goiânia nas férias.

“Eu sempre voltava nas férias para Goiânia e eu a visitava na sua casa, que por acaso também era a floricultura da sua mãe. Mas, em uma dessas férias, ela não estava mais lá e eu nunca mais a vi”, relatou a médica no vídeo postado nas redes. Após o vídeo chegar a Gabriela, a professora respondeu nos comentários. “Sou eu, Isa!! Seu sorriso continua o mesmo”, disse.

A professora de inglês contou que se mudou para Florianópolis (SC) e que, por isso, a família dela fechou a floricultura que ficava na Avenida Ricardo Paranhos. “Isabela também me emocionou muito com esse carinho que perdurou por todos esses anos”, declarou.

articles.title: Motorista fica presa às ferragens e pede ajuda aos bombeiros no PI | G1
articles.standfirst: A mulher foi localizada após pouco mais de uma hora de buscas. Durante o contato, a mulher relatou que não sabia exatamente o que havia acontecido.
articles.summary: A mulher foi localizada após pouco mais de uma hora de buscas. Durante o contato, a mulher relatou que não sabia exatamente o que havia acontecido.
articles.body:
Uma mulher ficou presa às ferragens após sofrer um acidente na noite de domingo (6), na BR-343, em Brasileira, no Norte do Piauí. Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Piauí (CBMEPI), ela mesma acionou a equipe de resgate enquanto permaneceu presa dentro do veículo. A vítima foi localizada após pouco mais de uma hora de buscas.

Durante o contato, a mulher relatou que não sabia exatamente o que havia acontecido, mas suspeitava que o carro tivesse capotado, segundo os bombeiros.

Os bombeiros foram informados de que o carro saiu da pista e parou em uma área de vegetação às margens da rodovia. Na primeira ligação, a motorista relatou que estava presa às ferragens e havia percebido fumaça saindo do veículo.

Minutos depois, a motorista voltou a ligar para a emergência e informou que continuava presa às ferragens e que o carro poderia estar pegando fogo.

A mulher foi encontrada dentro do veículo cerca de uma hora após o acionamento da equipe. No local, os bombeiros constataram que o carro não havia pegado fogo.

Para retirar a vítima das ferragens, os bombeiros precisaram cortar a porta do lado do motorista. Ela estava sozinha no automóvel.

Após ser retirada do carro, a mulher recebeu os primeiros atendimentos do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) e foi encaminhada para um hospital da região. O estado de saúde dela não havia sido informado até a última atualização desta reportagem.

articles.title: Veja o que se sabe sobre a morte da empresária após plástica | G1
articles.standfirst: Andreia Vieira Gaspar morreu após passar por uma série de cirurgias plásticas no rosto e pescoço que durou cerca de dez horas. O médico otorrinolaringologista Lessandro Martins foi responsável pelos seis procedimentos, entre eles uma ritidoplastia profunda e lipoaspiração no pescoço.
articles.summary: Veja o que se sabe sobre a morte de Andreia Vieira Gaspar após passar por uma série de cirurgias plásticas no rosto e pescoço.
articles.body:
A empresária Andreia Vieira Gaspar, de 51 anos, morreu no dia 12 de agosto após ser submetida a procedimentos no rosto em uma clínica em Goiânia. Conforme já apurado pelo g1 , o médico otorrinolaringologista Lessandro Martins foi responsável pelos seis procedimentos no rosto , entre eles uma ritidoplastia profunda e lipoaspiração no pescoço.

Andreia passou ainda por uma frontoplastia, mentoplastia e blefaroplastia, além de aplicação de gordura no rosto. A empresária pagou R$ 118 mil pelos procedimentos e não passou por uma consulta presencial com o médico antes da operação, segundo a irmã de Andreia, Djiane Vieira.

Ao g1 , a defesa de Lessandro Martins lamentou a perda de Andreia e disse que todos os exames e procedimentos pré-operatórios foram seguidos adequadamente (leia nota completa abaixo). O texto diz ainda que o hospital contava com a estrutura exigida para a realização do procedimento.

O relatório de um laudo solicitado pela família informou que o procedimento teve início às 7h45 e se estendeu até as 17h40, quando Andreia foi levada de volta ao quarto após quase dez horas no centro cirúrgico. A causa da morte foi trombose aguda e infarto pulmonar.

Segundo Djiane, a empresária tinha vindo da Espanha para a capital para realizar os procedimentos.

Empresária Andreia Vieira Gaspar morreu após cirurgia na face com o médico Lessandro Martins. — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhanguera/Redes sociais de Lessandro Martins

Ao g1 , Djiane contou que a equipe médica responsável pelo atendimento da empresária tentou reanimá-la por quase duas horas no dia da morte. Segundo a irmã, os profissionais iniciaram as tentativas de reanimação às 2h40 e pararam por volta das 4h30.

Djiane, que acompanhava a irmã no quarto, relatou que Andreia voltou da operação bastante debilitada, com inchaço excessivo e queixas constantes de falta de ar e sensação de sufocamento. De acordo com prints apresentados por Djiane, enquanto presenciava a irmã passando mal e apresentando piora na respiração, ela implorou, em um grupo de mensagens com a equipe médica, que Andreia fosse socorrida. A família denuncia que houve negligência no atendimento.

“A minha irmã tá morrendo. Pelo amor de Deus. Vocês atende, ninguém aparece. Pelo amor de Deus.”

Andreia morava na Espanha havia cinco anos e foi para Goiânia para realizar o procedimento que, segundo a família, era um sonho antigo.

“Foram dois anos que ela ficou poupando. Não é fácil você reunir R$ 118 mil ganhando salário. Então era um sonho na cabeça dela que já vinha de anos”, afirmou Djiane.

Ela teria começado a se organizar financeiramente para fazer a cirurgia cerca de dois anos antes. O procedimento custou R$ 118 mil. Segundo familiares, Andreia entrou em contato com a equipe médica pelas redes sociais e as tratativas foram feitas inicialmente por meio de mensagens.

O Ministério Público de Goiás informou que encaminhou à Polícia Civil um ofício solicitando a abertura de inquérito para investigar a possível prática de homicídio culposo.

A família também questiona o atendimento prestado durante o pós-operatório e afirma que Andreia poderia ter recebido assistência médica antes da piora do quadro.

A defesa do Hospital Ankar afirmou que Andreia recebeu atendimento de emergência imediato, com assistência das equipes médica e de enfermagem e adoção das medidas necessárias diante do quadro apresentado. O hospital também informou que os registros do atendimento estão documentados em prontuário e poderão ser disponibilizados às autoridades.

A família afirma que pretende colaborar com as investigações e busca esclarecimentos sobre o atendimento prestado à empresária antes da morte.

Otorrino com mais de 20 anos de experiência em plástica facial

O médico otorrinolaringologista Lessandro Martins, responsável pela cirurgia plástica da empresária Andreia Vieira Gaspar, de 51 anos, que morreu após a realização dos procedimentos, tem mais de 20 anos de experiência em plástica facial, com ênfase em otorrinolaringologia, segundo informações do seu site profissional. Mas, há pelo menos seis anos, ele se dedica exclusivamente aos procedimentos faciais.

Nas redes sociais, ele informa ser de Curitiba, com atuações em Goiânia e em Rio Verde, onde mora. Segundo o portfólio, Lessandro é graduado em medicina pela Pontifícia Universidade Católica de Campinas (PUC-Camp), com experiência em cirurgia em Bogotá, na Colômbia.

O médico também é membro fundador da Academia de Plástica Facial e membro da Academia Americana de Cirurgia Plástica da Face e da Academia Europeia de Cirurgia Plástica da Face. A clínica na qual Lessandro atua e que leva o seu nome tem uma equipe com pelo menos outros sete profissionais, segundo dados do site.

A defesa do Dr. Lessandro Paiva Martins lamenta profundamente o falecimento de Andreia Vieira Gaspar, ocorrido em 12 de agosto de 2026, e manifesta sua solidariedade aos familiares e amigos.

Acima de qualquer questão técnica, estão a perda de uma vida e a dor de uma família. Desde o início, o médico tem colaborado ativamente com a apuração dos fatos, apresentando toda a documentação que comprova o cumprimento dos protocolos adotados.

Os exames imprescindíveis foram solicitados, inclusive a avaliação de risco cirúrgico. A paciente foi avaliada e liberada por seu médico particular para a realização da cirurgia. Eletrocardiograma, raio-X de tórax e análises laboratoriais foram avaliados e estavam adequados; os resultados não indicavam infecção nem apontavam impedimento para a intervenção.

Andreia fazia uso de terapia hormonal, composta por testosterona em gel, estradiol em gel e progesterona micronizada por via oral, informação que havia sido comunicada à equipe do Dr. Lessandro. Como medida de cautela, foi orientada a suspensão da terapia hormonal uma semana antes da cirurgia. De acordo com a avaliação médica, considerando as medicações utilizadas e suas vias de administração, o esquema hormonal não representava, por si só, risco trombótico aumentado relevante que impedisse a realização do procedimento.

A equipe do Dr. Lessandro também estava ciente de que a paciente viria de Madrid, na Espanha, para o Brasil antes da cirurgia. Há registro de contato da própria paciente com a equipe, cerca de uma semana antes do procedimento, informando que já se encontrava no país. Considerando seu perfil clínico, os exames pré-operatórios dentro da normalidade e a ausência de fatores de risco trombótico conhecidos relevantes, o intervalo entre a viagem aérea e a cirurgia foi considerado adequado, e não havia contraindicação ao procedimento em razão do deslocamento.

Andreia também passou por consulta presencial com o Dr. Lessandro antes do procedimento. Foi indicada e realizada uma cirurgia facial, considerada um ato cirúrgico único, com duração adequada e dentro dos parâmetros da medicina.

A intervenção ocorreu em estabelecimento devidamente habilitado, com estrutura compatível e em conformidade com as exigências aplicáveis, contando também com suporte de UTI móvel.

Cabe o registro de que tudo transcorreu normalmente, inclusive no pós-operatório. A paciente se alimentou, conversou e estava bem até passar mal horas depois.

Após a intercorrência, o Dr. Lessandro foi avisado e participou, em conjunto com outros médicos, das manobras de reanimação, que se estenderam por cerca de duas horas na tentativa de reverter o quadro.

Segundo a necropsia realizada pelo Serviço de Verificação de Óbitos (SVO), foi identificada trombose coronariana aguda em tronco da artéria coronária esquerda, em coração livre de doença aterosclerótica, além de infartos pulmonares bilaterais. O óbito foi classificado como decorrente de causa natural.

Três pareceres elaborados por profissionais distintos e independentes analisaram o caso e concluíram, de forma convergente, que não há nexo causal, direto, indireto ou concausal, entre a atuação do Dr. Lessandro e o óbito, tampouco elementos que caracterizem negligência, imprudência ou imperícia.

Em 28 de agosto de 2026, foi realizada a exumação do corpo para avaliações complementares, cujos resultados ainda são aguardados. A defesa seguirá à disposição das autoridades para os esclarecimentos necessários.

A advogada responsável pela defesa do Hospital Ankar, Cristiene Pereira Couto, informa que a unidade lamenta profundamente o falecimento da paciente Andréia Vieira Gaspar e manifesta solidariedade aos seus familiares.

A defesa esclarece que a paciente recebeu atendimento de emergência imediato, com assistência da equipe médica e de enfermagem e adoção das medidas necessárias diante do quadro apresentado.

É importante destacar que a avaliação e os exames pré-operatórios foram realizados externamente, antes da admissão da paciente no Hospital Ankar para a realização do procedimento cirúrgico.

A partir da intercorrência, a paciente foi prontamente assistida pelos profissionais presentes, com utilização da estrutura hospitalar necessária e realização das medidas de emergência indicadas.

Todos os registros referentes ao atendimento estão devidamente documentados em prontuário, que poderá ser disponibilizado às autoridades competentes sempre que necessário.

O Hospital Ankar permanece à disposição para prestar todos os esclarecimentos pertinentes e colaborar integralmente com a apuração dos fatos, com transparência, responsabilidade e respeito à paciente, à família e aos profissionais envolvidos.

articles.title: Barco-Escola em Cubatão movido a energia solar é inaugurado | G1
articles.standfirst: Projeto percorre os rios Casqueiro e Santana e terá atividades gratuitas para estudantes; aos fins de semana, população poderá participar de passeio turístico-educativo.
articles.summary: O Barco-Escola Neosão oferece atividades gratuitas para estudantes e passeios turísticos pagos aos fins de semana pelos rios Casqueiro e Santana em Cubatão.
articles.body:
Barco-Escola utiliza energia solar e tecnologia para promover educação ambiental em Cubatão (SP). — Foto: Divulgação/Prefeitura de Cubatão

A Prefeitura de Cubatão (SP) lançou o Barco-Escola Neosão, projeto voltado à educação ambiental, sustentabilidade e turismo. A embarcação movida a energia solar fará atividades com estudantes durante a semana e passeios turísticos aos fins de semana e feriados.

A iniciativa é realizada por meio da Secretaria de Meio Ambiente, Segurança Climática e Bem-Estar Animal, em parceria com a Usiminas e o Instituto Meu Oceano.

De segunda a sexta-feira, o barco-escola atenderá gratuitamente, de forma prioritária, alunos das redes municipal, estadual e particular, além de instituições conveniadas à Prefeitura.

Aos fins de semana e feriados, o passeio será aberto ao público em geral. As primeiras atividades estavam previstas para sábado (5) e domingo (6), além desta segunda-feira (7), feriado da Independência do Brasil, a partir das 9h - os horários dependem das condições da maré e do clima.

Os ingressos custam R$ 45, e podem ser adquiridos após contato com o número (11) 98911-8339. Moradores de Cubatão, estudantes, professores, pessoas com deficiência e idosos pagam meia-entrada, de R$ 22,50, mediante comprovação. Crianças de até três anos não pagam.

O trajeto educativo tem duração de cerca de 1h30 e passa pelos rios Casqueiro e Santana. Durante a experiência, educadores apresentam informações sobre o manguezal, a biodiversidade e a história da cidade.

Segundo a prefeitura, o barco foi desenvolvido pelo Instituto Meu Oceano e conta com uma placa solar bifacial, capaz de captar a luz que incide diretamente sobre a estrutura e também o reflexo da radiação na água. A embarcação tem autonomia de até cinco horas.

O Neosão pode alcançar até 5 nós, o equivalente a 9,26 km/h, mas navega normalmente a cerca de 7,4 km/h. A velocidade reduzida e o baixo nível de ruído permitem a aproximação das margens sem causar impactos desnecessários à fauna.

Para a prefeitura, a iniciativa também demonstra o potencial de Cubatão para desenvolver o transporte hidroviário sustentável e fortalecer a conexão entre o município e outras cidades da Baixada Santista.

Passeios pelo Rio Casqueiro permitem conhecer as belezas naturais e a biodiversidade do munícipio. — Foto: Divulgação/Prefeitura de Cubatão

articles.title: Ainda dá tempo: concurso tem 430 vagas e salários de até R$ 9,5 mil | G1
articles.standfirst: Salários chegam a R$ 9,5 mil; há oportunidades para candidatos com níveis fundamental, médio, técnico e superior
articles.summary: Salários chegam a R$ 9,5 mil; há oportunidades para candidatos com níveis fundamental, médio, técnico e superior
articles.body:
Rio Verde de Mato Grosso (MS) — Foto: Divulgação

As inscrições para o concurso público da Prefeitura de Rio Verde de Mato Grosso , a cerca de 200 km de Campo Grande, terminam nesta segunda-feira (7). Ao todo, são 430 vagas imediatas para diferentes áreas e níveis de escolaridade. Os salários chegam a R$ 9.526,98, valor previsto para os cargos de médico.

O cadastro pode ser feito até as 23h59 desta segunda-feira, no horário de Mato Grosso do Sul, pelo site da organizadora do concurso.

Há oportunidades para quem tem formação nos níveis fundamental, médio, técnico e superior. Entre os cargos com maior número de vagas estão servente de limpeza, com 50 vagas; professor dos anos iniciais, com 75; monitor e recreador, com 36; e assistente de administração, com 30 vagas.

Também são oferecidas 25 vagas para professor de educação infantil e outras 25 para professor de educação interativa.

Para os cargos de nível superior, os salários iniciais variam de R$ 4.734,08 a R$ 9.526,98. Além de médicos, o concurso tem vagas para enfermeiros, farmacêuticos, psicólogos, nutricionistas, odontólogos, fisioterapeutas e assistentes sociais, entre outras áreas. Nesses cargos, as remunerações chegam a R$ 5.116,35, conforme a função.

Na área da educação, o salário inicial dos professores é de R$ 2.693,62, para uma jornada de 20 horas semanais.

Para os cargos de nível médio, o salário inicial é de R$ 1.705,45. Já para as funções que exigem formação técnica, a remuneração fica em torno de R$ 2 mil, dependendo do cargo.

A taxa custa R$ 130 para cargos de nível superior e R$ 90 para funções de níveis médio e fundamental.

O edital também prevê isenção da taxa para candidatos inscritos no CadÚnico. O prazo para solicitar o benefício, no entanto, terminou em 18 de agosto.

As provas estão previstas para ocorrer em datas diferentes, de acordo com o nível e a área do cargo:

27 de setembro: cargos de nível superior e técnico;

1º de novembro: cargos de nível fundamental.

Inscrições: até as 23h59 desta segunda-feira (7), pelo site da organizadora.

Taxa: R$ 130 para nível superior e R$ 90 para níveis médio e fundamental.

articles.title: 4 months after marriage, couple found dead in Kerala Lake
articles.summary: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: A newlywed couple was found dead in Sasthamcotta Lake near Ambalakkadavu, Kollam, on Sunday morning, with police suspecting suicid.
articles.body: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: A newlywed couple was found dead in Sasthamcotta Lake near Ambalakkadavu, Kollam, on Sunday morning, with police suspecting suicide. The deceased have been identified as Rajeev, 26 and Abhirami, 19, a resident of Sasthamcotta.According to police, Abhirami’s body was first spotted near Ambalakkadavu early Sunday morning. Following the discovery, a search operation was launched by the Sasthamcotta fire and rescue personnel. Rajeev’s body was subsequently recovered from the lake, around 50 metres from where Abhirami’s body had been found.Police suspect that the couple entered the lake in the early hours of Sunday. However, the exact circumstances that led to their deaths are yet to be established.Rajeev and Abhirami had been in a relationship before getting married around four months ago. Their marriage was reportedly solemnised despite strong opposition from both families. Following the marriage, the couple had been staying in a rented house.According to relatives and police, the couple had maintained little or no contact with their respective families after the marriage.Rajeev was working as a cleaning staff member at Ambalamkunnu school. Police said the couple had been summoned to the Puyappally police station last month for counselling. The reason for the couple’s decision to end their lives, however, remains unclear.The bodies were kept at the Sasthamcotta taluk hospital mortuary and were later handed over to relatives.Sasthamcotta Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to ascertain the circumstances leading to the deaths. Police will also gather information from relatives and other persons who had been in contact with the couple in recent days.Stay updated with the latest Thiruvananthapuram news. articles.title: Nuclear-capable warship that capsized when launched finally joins North Korea’s fleet
articles.summary: North Korea has commissioned its second modern guided-missile destroyer, a remarkable recovery for a vessel that capsized when it was launched in May 2025, infuriating the country’s leader Kim Jong Un who called it a “criminal act.”
articles.body: North Korea has commissioned its second modern guided-missile destroyer, a remarkable recovery for a vessel that capsized when it was launched in May 2025, infuriating the country’s leader Kim Jong Un who called it a “criminal act.” Kim said Sunday’s commissioning of the destroyer Kang Kon was a result of the country’s “self-respect, will and strong spirit.” He added that the nuclear-capable warship would send a strong message of deterrence to North Korea’s enemies, according to the state-run Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). It’s quite a turnaround from last year when the Kang Kon was being launched, a malfunction in the mechanism caused the stern to slide prematurely into the water, crushing parts of the hull and leaving the bow stranded on the shipway, KCNA reported at the time. A day later, state media reported the damage was not as bad as initially feared. The Kang Kon is the second in the Choe Hyon-class of destroyers. Displacing about 5,000 tons, they are North Korea’s largest-ever warships. The lead ship was commissioned in June, with Kim saying at the time that it represented a new chapter in North Korea’s military history and that its navy has “put an end to over 70 years of its stagnation.” On Sunday, he echoed those thoughts, saying the commissioning of the Kang Kon “constitutes a historic event” for the navy’s capabilities. The North Korean naval fleet has long been eclipsed by South Korean and United States naval forces, which have modern warships and submarines with sophisticated electronics and powerful missile launch capabilities. Kim has been trying to transform Pyongyang’s navy into a “nuclear armed force” to deter its adversaries. New naval bases are being constructed on the country’s east coast to host an expanding fleet, Kim said Sunday, according to KCNA. Kim has called for North Korean shipyards to turn out two new surface ships a year, including cruisers double the size of the Choe Hyon. And North Korea has also claimed to be building a large nuclear-powered attack submarine, equal in size to the US Navy’s attack subs. Images released in December showed Kim inspecting the sub in an indoor construction facility. Kim may have been referring to any or all of those claims when he said Sunday that “we are executing an important plan to enhance our naval force. I will, again, prove that to the world after eight months,” according to KCNA. Attending Sunday’s launch ceremony with Kim was his daughter, who is thought to be named Ju Ae and who experts think Kim is grooming to be his successor. Images released by state media showed the girl posing with her father and the ship’s crew for a group photo after getting a tour of the vessel.

articles.title: Armed assailant attacks Ohio Democratic candidate during campaign stop
articles.summary: Patrick Havas, 38, arrested with weapons after injuring several at Ohio Democrat Amy Acton’s campaign stop.
articles.body:
An armed assailant in the United States attacked the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, Amy Acton, during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair, injuring several people, campaign officials said.

The individual lunged at Acton as she was speaking on Sunday. Acton was unharmed after the incident, campaign spokesperson ⁠⁠Addie Bullock said in a statement.

The suspect, Patrick Havas, 38, was arrested with multiple weapons after knocking volunteers to the ground, according to a statement from Mahoning County Democratic Party chairman Chris Anderson.

The Ohio State Highway Patrol, which made the arrest, said Havas had two pistols and a Taser before he was stopped by troopers.

Police officers from Mahoning County said two handguns and a set of brass knuckles were recovered after the incident.

Havas was booked on charges of disorderly conduct and two counts of assault at the county jail, but no other details were available pending an investigation, the highway patrol added.

The suspect knocked ⁠⁠down two older adults during the ⁠⁠incident, Sheriff Jerry Greene told local NBC outlet 21 News.

Ohio Governor Mike DeWine condemned the attack in a statement and said Ohio police at the fair quickly responded to the incident at the Mahoning County Democratic booth. DeWine, a Republican, is unable to run for re-election because of term limits.

Acton’s Republican opponent in the general election, Vivek Ramaswamy, called Sunday’s attack “completely unacceptable” in a campaign statement. Ramaswamy, leveraging national name recognition and alliances with the tech industry and President Donald Trump, has raised record funds and spent on advertisements criticising Acton.

Federal political committees spent more than $40m on security during the 2023–2024 campaign cycle, according to the most recent publicly available data cited by the nonpartisan group Public Service Alliance.

A Trump-backed political group recently announced it will spend $10m on television and digital advertisements in the state of Texas ahead of the upcoming elections. Trump said he planned to spend up to $500m to help Republican candidates in their races.

The Ohio gubernatorial race is one of the most closely watched in this year’s midterm elections. Campaigns are entering the final six weeks before the election on November 3.

The attempted attack is the latest in a string of political violence cases in the US, which has seen a rise in similar incidents over the past decade.

In 2025, Minnesota lawmaker Melissa Hortman and her husband, Mark Hortman, were assassinated at their home. The husband of former Democratic House of Representatives Speaker Nancy Pelosi was assaulted in 2022 .

Trump was also the target of two assassination attempts during the 2024 presidential campaign, while an armed man attempted to breach security at this year’s White House Correspondents’ Association Dinner, where the president was in attendance.

articles.title: The man behind the flow of Robbie Williams' shows
articles.summary: Karl Brazil is the singer's musical director and talks of how they draw up the set list and more.
articles.body:
As a singer, Robbie Williams is known for his big hits - Let Me Entertain You, Rock DJ and, of course, Angels.

But when the music star goes on stage, what happens behind the scenes? Karl Brazil knows, as he is the singer's musical director and drummer who is, in his words, responsible for the "flow of the shows".

He said there were pre-show "wedding reception discos" on the recent world tour, before a performance in front of thousands.

"What we do before the shows, is a have a little pre-disco," Brazil said.

"We have a playlist, we get together in a room with flashing lights and vibe each other up.

"So by the time we get on stage, it looks like we have been at a wedding reception together, it's fantastic."

Williams has been playing shows across the globe as part of his BRITPOP 2026 stadium tour, due to conclude in New Zealand in November.

Throughout it, Brazil, from Solihull in the West Midlands, said set lists changed depending on different destinations.

"If someone buys a ticket for a show, they have got to hear the hits, so of course we make sure that the set list is right for each territory. Because Rob is so big everywhere. Thirty years of music, you have to make sure," the 49-year-old added.

"We look at it with huge detail, every show.

"For example, Candy, huge [in Europe]. But when we go to Australia, it's not that known. It's not something that needs to be in the show out there."

The on-stage tour team consists of a 10-piece band, eight dancers and Williams himself.

While performing on the current stadium tour, the drummer said he made sure to be "there for Rob" with his "eyes on everything as the driving force".

He added that the performers were all friends, working together each night to put on a unique show.

"Each band member has to be great at what they do, they have to be as good on stage and off stage," Brazil said.

"I think it's really important, like with any team, the togetherness is so important.

"When people see us on stage, they can see that we get on and that we're friends."

Throughout the years, Brazil has been musical director for several other high-profile music artists such as 5 Seconds of Summer, Five, Rita Ora, and he had toured and recorded as drummer for James Blunt, Ed Sheeran, Elton John and Niall Horan.

Another artist he worked with recently was Black Sabbath's Tony Iommi, drumming on his latest album From the Dark.

"This started back in the Covid era. I went into the studio, didn't know what was going to come of it," Brazil said.

"I'm delighted to say I made the record, and the first day I went in and Tony was there we got on so well. Tony really let me express myself.

"I thoroughly enjoyed being on this record, it's a massive career highlight."

Brazil said the new album had in his view "gone down a storm", with Iommi himself describing the collaboration as "something different, but really honoured".

Iommi added that the recording was rooted in talent from Birmingham.

"The great thing, the whole thing has come from Birmingham," he said

"All the merchandise, all made in Birmingham. We've tried to keep the whole thing wrapped around Birmingham."

articles.title: Report recommends £1 per night North Yorkshire tourist tax
articles.summary: The visitor levy could raise up to £26m for the region, the new report finds.
articles.body:
A new report has recommended imposing a £1 per night tourist tax across York and North Yorkshire.

Commissioned by the mayor of York and North Yorkshire, David Skaith, the Policy Lab review said the levy could raise £26m for the region each year, which could be ring-fenced for tourism-related purposes.

According to the report, potential exemptions could be made for low-cost stays in a bid to reduce the burden on small operators and campsites.

Skaith said he believed introducing the visitor levy "could be a total game changer for us".

Evidence reviewed in the report found growth remained steady when a visitor levy was introduced in high appeal destinations, such as Edinburgh, Manchester, Paris and Barcelona.

It said substantial revenue could be generated from the scheme, with different models raising millions of pounds.

However, the report said the policy involved "clear trade-offs", particularly between fairness, simplicity and administrative complexity.

The flat rate model of £1 was preferred to a percentage-based model due to its simplicity and predictable revenue but it had a higher impact on budget accommodation.

The report recommended the model also have a built-in review mechanism.

Skaith said: "York and North Yorkshire has something for everyone. Millions visit every year, and that's why a visitor levy could be a total game changer for us.

"Thriving communities and thriving destinations go hand in hand, but welcoming so many visitors puts pressure on the infrastructure and services our residents rely on.

"We must get this right for our county so we can invest in our communities, and our hospitality and tourism businesses."

Professor Brendan Paddison, who is the academic lead for the Policy Lab, explained the report was not about making the case for or against the visitor levy but it provided evidence for an informed discussion.

"Our findings suggest that a visitor levy is a viable option worth exploring further, but the detail matters," he said.

"Any future levy would need to be simple and proportionate, underpinned by transparent governance and meaningful engagement with businesses and communities.

"Crucially, there must also be a clear commitment that any revenue raised is invested back into the places and visitor economy that generate it, with benefits that are visible to businesses, visitors and communities across York and North Yorkshire."

The report comes as results of the national consultation into visitor levies are expected in the coming weeks.

Combined authorities are set to receive powers to implement them later this year under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Bill.

articles.title: Indonesia volcano eruption leaves 270,000 stranded as airports extend closure
articles.summary: Anak Krakatau, which lies about 150km from the capital Jakarta, began erupting late on Friday.
articles.body:
Some 270,000 passengers have been left stranded across Indonesia after a volcanic eruption grounded more than 2,000 flights and forced airports to suspend operations for a second day.

Anak Krakatau, located 150km (90mi) from Jakarta, began erupting late on Friday, producing lava fountains and sending volcanic ash into the capital and the Lampung province. It stayed seismically active throughout the weekend.

Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International decided not to reopen at 18:00 (11:00 GMT) as planned due to the continued presence of volcanic ash near its airspace.

A press release from the airport said flights would now resume at 23:59 on Monday.

Halim Perdanakusuma, a smaller airport that caters to civil and military flights, will also remain closed until then.

Snaking queues formed at the departure halls in Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport on Monday as stranded passengers sought refunds and tried to get updates on when they would be able to fly.

Finna, who was supposed to fly home to Jakarta from Malang, a city in East Java, on Sunday morning, described the frezny at the airport as flights got repeatedly rescheduled.

"It was very crowded because passengers from the morning flights had piled up, while those scheduled for later departures still didn't know what would happen," the 46-year-old told BBC Indonesian.

"We were all glued to the flight information screens."

Not wanting to deal with the uncertainty, Finna eventually spent the night on two intercity trains before arriving in Jakarta at 03:00 on Monday.

"Everyone seems to be racking their brains [figuring alternative transportation options]", said Jo Shaw, who was visiting Indonesia with members of her conservation charity Save the Rhino International.

Shaw's team had axed their plans to camp out at Java's Ujung Kulon National Park after authorities raised its alert level for the Anak Krakatau volcano.

"Being stranded in an airport hotel is a relatively minor inconvenience to be resolved in a few days hopefully," Shaw said, adding that she was more concerned about the teams working on the ground with the rhinos under such environmental conditions.

A newly wed Malaysian couple who had just spent a week in Bali said they were told that the next flight back to Kuala Lumpur wouldn't be until 11 September.

"What are we going to do here for another five days? We only prepared enough money for our honeymoon and [were supposed] to go home yesterday," Amir Hamzah told Malaysia's national news agency Bernama.

"We thought we would just sleep at the airport for a few hours and then take the morning flight home [on Monday]. We never thought we would end up being stuck here for days," the 29-year-old said.

On Monday, Indonesia's Geological Agency warned that "the probability of further eruptions in the coming periods remains high".

Volcanic ash reached as high as 6,000m on the Java side of the volcano and 15,000m on the Sumatra side and in some parts of Java's westernmost province Banten, the meteorological agency BMKG said.

Anak Krakatau sits on the Sunda Strait about midway between the islands of Java and Sumatra.

The most recent eruption occurred at 20:23 on Sunday, according to the agency.

"We ‌cannot ascertain when this ‌will end due to the dynamic weather," Transport Minister Dudy Purwagandhi said in relation to the temporary closures of the affected airports.

Dudy said on Sunday that authorities across the airports have been conducting tests every 30 minutes "to anticipate whether the ash spread is widening or subsiding".

Authorities have warned against approaching or engaging in activities within a 3km radius from the active crater, while ships passing through the Sunda Strait have also been prohibited from entering an exclusion zone of 3km radius from it.

Authorities have also confirmed there is no tsunami warning linked to the recent activity of the volcano.

Anak Krakatau, which means Child of Krakatoa, has been sporadically active since it emerged from the sea at the beginning of last century in the caldera formed after the 1883 eruption of Mount Krakatoa.

The volcano collapsed in December 2018 triggering a huge tsunami which killed over 400 people, and displaced and injured thousands more on the nearby coastlines of Sumatra and Java.

Scientists found that some of the chunks of rock that slid from the volcano when it collapsed were about 70-90m high.

The Pacific Ring of Fire refers to a string of volcanoes, earthquake sites and tectonic plates around the Pacific. It spreads across 40,000km (25,000 miles) from the southern tip of South America all the way to New Zealand.

Roughly 90% of all earthquakes occur along the area and the ring is dotted with 75% of all active volcanoes on Earth, that's 452 individual active volcanoes.

articles.title: In 1912, Alabama monk Brother Joseph Zoettl began recreating landmarks he had mostly never seen; 46 years later, at age 80, he finished the last of 125 miniatures
articles.summary: US News: In 1912, a Bavarian-born Benedictine monk at St. Bernard Abbey in Cullman, Alabama, began building miniature cement copies of some of the world’s best.
articles.body: In 1912, a Bavarian-born Benedictine monk at St. Bernard Abbey in Cullman, Alabama, began building miniature cement copies of some of the world’s best-known religious sites, using postcards, pieces of marble and donated costume jewellery as his main guides. Brother Joseph Zoettl spent the next 46 years turning a four-acre hillside quarry into the Ave Maria Grotto. He completed his 125th and final model in 1958 at the age of 80, according to historical records held by the Library of Congress and the official Ave Maria Grotto archives. Although Zoettl had visited only six of the places he recreated, he produced detailed models of landmarks including St. Peter’s Basilica in Rome, the Leaning Tower of Pisa, ancient sites in Jerusalem and the Alamo. The four-acre park remains a major folk-art attraction in northern Alabama and welcomes thousands of visitors each year on the active monastery grounds.From boiler room operator to visionary outsider artistBorn in Landshut, Bavaria, in 1878, Zoettl moved to the United States in 1892 at the age of 14 to join the newly established Benedictine community at St. Bernard Abbey, according to biographical records from the shrine. Zoettl suffered injuries early in life that left him with a physical disability. He was given the job of operating the abbey’s coal-fired power station and water pump house, a demanding role that could keep him working for up to 17 hours a day. During his short breaks, he began making small stone grottos from discarded masonry and furnace slag. His early miniature creations were placed along the abbey’s recreation paths and also sold in the monastery souvenir shop. As his work became larger and more detailed, abbey leaders set aside a former stone quarry on the campus in 1932 for a permanent display. They asked Zoettl to build a central 27-foot stone cave dedicated to the Virgin Mary.Architectural creation through recycled materials and postcardsWith almost no formal training in architecture or sculpture, Zoettl built his models using ordinary Portland cement mixed with donated scrap materials. Visitors and supporters sent materials from around the world, including cold-cream jars, broken teacups, stained-glass pieces, seashells, marbles and old chandelier crystals, according to Roadside Architecture and regional historical reviews. Since he could not afford to travel internationally, Zoettl depended on black-and-white photographs, souvenir postcards and biblical descriptions to create his models. This approach gave the buildings unusual proportions, with their size adjusted to fit the natural stone ledges of the quarry. Among his 125 completed structures are detailed models of the Basilica of Our Lady of Lourdes, the Great Wall of China, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon and Mission San Juan Capistrano in California. Zoettl completed his final work, a model of the Basilica in Lourdes, France, in 1958. He died three years later, in October 1961, at the age of 83, and was buried in the nearby abbey cemetery.Preservation and heritage status in AlabamaThe Ave Maria Grotto was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1984. The listing recognised its cultural importance as a major example of American outsider art and visionary environment construction. The monastic community and specialist preservation workers oversee the maintenance of the four-acre site. Over the years, Alabama’s humid climate has exposed the delicate concrete and glass structures to weather damage, requiring careful restoration. Staff conservators continue to apply protective sealants and repair individual masonry pieces, helping preserve Zoettl’s life’s work in its original stone quarry setting on the St. Bernard Abbey grounds.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Fireworks explosion kills at least 10 at Mexico festival
articles.summary: Pyrotechnic material exploded during the festival for a patron saint in a town in Mexico State, collapsing a wall, killing at least 10 people and injuring another 64, Mexican authorities said.
articles.body: Pyrotechnic material exploded during the festival for a patron saint in a town in Mexico State, collapsing a wall, killing at least 10 people and injuring another 64, Mexican authorities said. The explosion occurred Saturday night next to the Nuestra Señora de la Luz church in Temascalcingo, a municipality in central Mexico with 66,000 residents. Hundreds of them were preparing to watch a fireworks display that is part of a religious festival when the blast occurred. The municipality is about 160 kilometers (100 miles) northwest of Mexico City. The cause of the explosion has not been determined and the Mexico State Attorney General’s Office has opened an investigation. A local bishop said two priests are among the injured. A video on social media shows the aftermath of the blast, with dozens of people walking through smoke and debris in search of survivors. Explosions involving pyrotechnics are common in Mexico, where fireworks are frequently used in street celebrations and religious festivals. Almost four years ago, a powerful fireworks explosion in a village in the municipality of Huejutla, in the central state of Hidalgo, left 17 people injured.

articles.title: Former USCIS official, accomplice charged in alleged $960K citizenship bribery scheme
articles.summary: A former USCIS official and his accomplice allegedly accepted nearly $960,000 in bribes to fast-track citizenship applications, skipping key checks.
articles.body: A former senior U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services official and his accomplice are facing charges for an alleged bribery scheme in which they accepted nearly $960,000 in exchange for favors in the processing of immigration benefit applications, including citizenship cases. The former official, Lukman Owolabi Ganiyu, and his financial accomplice, Adeniyi Akeem Somoye, were arrested on federal charges for their roles in an alleged multi‑year scheme to receive illegal gratuities in exchange for manipulating and expediting immigration applications, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Texas. The pair were charged with conspiracy to receive illegal gratuities by a public official, and they were arrested on Wednesday. Investigators found extensive WhatsApp messages between Ganiyu, Somoye and numerous applicants whose immigration cases they handled, including thousands of messages and hundreds of calls. FEDS BUST ONE OF LARGEST ALLEGED MARRIAGE FRAUD SCHEMES IN US HISTORY INVOLVING 1,000-PLUS CHINESE SHAM UNIONS Between December 2019 and March 2026, the duo allegedly bypassed standard procedures by pushing applicants who paid bribes directly to Ganiyu, skipping key steps in the immigration process such as criminal background checks, interviews, standard USCIS processing protocols and other reviews, according to prosecutors. Prosecutors allege Ganiyu altered the USCIS system to fast-track applications in exchange for money. He allegedly fast-tracked citizenship for Somoye before he approved residency applications for Somoye’s wife and child. Ganiyu allegedly rerouted applications from USCIS field offices in Minneapolis, Charlotte and Houston, bypassing local supervisors so he could approve them himself. FEDS SEIZE $40M IN GOLD BARS, CASH, ROLEXES FROM FORMER CIA OFFICIAL WHO FAKED BEING A NAVY PILOT Ganiyu received about $671,438 from citizenship applicants through Zelle and Cash App, along with $287,830 in cash deposits that prosecutors say were meant to conceal the money’s source, according to court documents, the New York Post reported. Acting as the alleged financial intermediary, Somoye processed roughly $1.7 million in transfers involving applicants, including through bank accounts, Zelle and Cash App, allegedly keeping a portion of the payments. He also deposited $449,010 in cash, court documents show, according to the New York Post. The complaint alleges that Ganiyu and Somoye often exchanged money "back and forth" with applicants. Most of the citizenship applications they handled involved applicants from African countries, according to prosecutors. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP According to prosecutors, Ganiyu resigned from USCIS in March, citing "personal reasons," several months before his arrest. "Selling immigration benefits for cash is a blatant abuse of public trust," U.S. Attorney Ryan Raybould said in a statement. "When a federal official puts a price tag on lawful status, we will intervene immediately." Each defendant faces up to five years in federal prison and a fine of up to $250,000.

articles.title: Israeli air attacks kill at least 11 people in southern Lebanon
articles.summary: Israeli air strike on residential building in Kfar Reman kills nine people, and two medics killed in drone attack.
articles.body:
Israeli air attacks in southern Lebanon have killed at least 11 people, including two children and two medics, Lebanese state media reported.

Israeli warplanes hit a residential building early on Monday in the town of Kfar Reman in southern Lebanon, killing nine people including two children, and wounding five others, Lebanon’s National News ‌Agency (NNA) reported.

A separate Israeli drone attack on a civilian vehicle in the town killed two medics inside the car, NNA said.

The Israeli military also struck a residential area in the town of Deir al-Zahrani in southern Lebanon overnight after it issued a forced evacuation order. The army says it targeted a building near a Hezbollah facility, which it claims was used to launch an explosive drone.

The attacks come a day after at least seven people were killed and 20 others were wounded in Israeli air raids on the nearby town of Arab Salim , also in the Nabatieh district .

Attacks have continued despite a United States-brokered framework agreement between Israel and Lebanon in June, which launched a “pilot zone” plan.

The pilot zones are meant to act as a test area for the Lebanese army to disarm Hezbollah and for the Israelis to withdraw, although they still occupy dozens of villages in southern Lebanon and Israel has refused further withdrawals, leading to a “stalled” diplomatic process, according to Al Jazeera’s Zeina Khodr.

Reporting from Kfar Reman, Khodr said “uncertainty and fear” are now the prevailing feelings in southern Lebanon, as people had started returning to the region and rebuilding their homes with the hope that attacks would stop after the Lebanon-Israel deal was signed in June.

“The feeling here is that Israel is trying to impose or establish new rules of engagement,” Khodr said. “People just do not know what is next. There’s been a wave of Israeli attacks over the past 48 hours. Civilians are being killed. Residential homes are being destroyed.”

“Recovery efforts by civil defence workers are continuing. They’ve been here throughout the night, but it’s no longer a rescue operation,” Khodr added. “It’s a recovery operation.”

Israeli strikes ⁠on Lebanon have killed more than 4,350 people and wounded over 12,300 since the conflict escalated in early March, according to Lebanon’s Health Ministry. It said in a report on Wednesday that there had been 179 Israeli attacks on Lebanese ambulance crews since March 2, killing 135 healthcare workers.

Though the US-brokered deal between Lebanon and Israel ‌saw violence decrease, Israeli forces have continued razing villages in its so-called “security zone” in southern Lebanon, carrying out air strikes both within the zone and to its north, mostly without forced evacuation orders.

articles.title: India teams search for survivors after Delhi building collapse kills six
articles.summary: Rescue teams work to locate survivors after New Delhi building collapse.
articles.body:
A multistorey building in the Indian capital, New Delhi, has collapsed, killing at least six people and trapping dozens of others.

Rescue teams are searching the rubble of the collapsed building, which housed mostly students, near a Delhi University campus in Satya Niketan on Sunday.

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) said it treated several victims after the incident.

“Out of the 10 patients, five were brought dead, while one patient who was in critical condition later succumbed to his injuries,” AIIMS said in a statement.

Crews from India’s disaster response agency, police and firefighters cleared debris with earthmovers and used detection dogs to search for those trapped inside. A nearby building was evacuated over concerns that it could also collapse.

Up to 40 people remain trapped under the rubble, according to fire officer Abhilash Malik. The number of survivors and the cause of the accident were not immediately clear.

A video filmed by a man trapped under the rubble as onlookers called for rescuers to help him has circulated online. Additional footage showed residents attempting to rescue survivors before disaster response teams arrived.

“The most important thing for us is to save the lives of these students. Rescue operations will carry on,” Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta told local news outlets.

“I assure you we won’t spare the guilty,” she said.

“Condolences to those who lost their loved ones. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured. Authorities are working at the site and assisting those affected in the mishap,” Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s office said on X.

Building collapses are frequent in parts of India during the rainy season from June to September. A similar incident occurred on Saturday after a three-storey building collapsed in northern India following heavy rain. No casualties were reported.

In 2025, at least 11 people were killed after a residential building collapsed in the northeastern district of New Delhi.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill nine
articles.summary: Lebanon says a recent Israeli escalation is jeopardising a US-brokered ceasefire meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.
articles.body:
Israeli air strikes on a village in southern Lebanon have killed at least nine people, the Lebanese health ministry says.

Eight people, including a child and two women, were killed in one strike that destroyed a residential building in Kfar Roummane overnight, according to the ministry. A second strike on a vehicle killed a paramedic.

The Israeli military said it was looking into the reports.

On Sunday, Israeli strikes killed seven people across southern Lebanon, as the Israeli military retaliated for what it said were drone attacks by the Shia Muslim armed group Hezbollah on troops in occupied areas of the country.

Lebanese President Joseph Aoun said the "dangerous escalation" was jeopardising June's US-brokered ceasefire, which was meant to end the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

He urged the international community to put pressure on Israel to stop the attacks.

Three farmers detained by Israel in Lebanon, village leader says

BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions

Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say

The Israeli military has intensified its strikes in southern Lebanon in recent days.

They have happened in places near the strip of territory that is occupied by Israeli troops, and large numbers of residents have again been fleeing those areas.

The latest attacks targeted Kfar Roummane, in Nabatieh district, which is only a few hundred metres from what the Israeli military calls its "security zone".

The first air strike destroyed a three-storey residential building near the town's Shuyuiya roundabout shortly after midnight, Lebanon's state-run National News Agency reported.

The Lebanese health ministry said that in addition to the eight people killed, 11 were injured, including four children, two women, and a paramedic from the Islamic Health Association, which is an emergency service linked to Hezbollah.

The second strike hit a vehicle carrying paramedics from the Islamic Risala Scout Association, killing one of them and injuring two others, according to the ministry. The Risala Scouts is an emergency service affiliated with the Amal movement, a Shia group allied to Hezbollah.

An initial report from the NNA said 11 people were killed in the two strikes.

The health ministry said the death toll "serves as further irrefutable evidence of the grave violations of international humanitarian law committed by the Israeli occupation, targeting medics and children".

A resident of Kfar Roummane, Sara Moallaem, 35, told the BBC that she had been asleep with her five children in their rental home when she heard the explosions.

She immediately grabbed her children and moved them into the home's "safe room" while they waited for the booms and the sirens to stop.

Some of those killed in the strikes were distant relatives of Sara's husband. She insisted they were civilians with no affiliation to Hezbollah.

Sara said she was planning to move her family to the coastal city of Sidon for their safety.

"During the day, it is almost normal, [with] people going back and forth. But as it comes near the night, things escalate, and now my children are afraid and I am packing now for the sixth or seventh time. It is terrible," she explained.

"Now that they are targeting civilians, I don't want to weep for my children."

Although there was no immediate comment from the Israeli military, the Israeli foreign ministry accused Hezbollah of "repeated drone attacks" and "attempting to rebuild its military capabilities in southern Lebanon".

The ministry also said the Iran-backed group had violated the ceasefire agreement.

The trilateral framework agreed by Lebanon, Israel and the US calls for Hezbollah to disarm, Israeli forces to withdraw gradually from southern Lebanon, and the Lebanese army to deploy across the area.

Lebanon was drawn into the war between Israel, the US and Iran on 2 March, when Hezbollah - which is supported by Iran - launched rockets into Israel in retaliation for a strike that killed Iran's supreme leader.

Israel responded by launching a bombing campaign across Lebanon and invading a significant part of the country's south.

At least 4,362 people have been killed in Lebanon during the conflict, including 395 women and 259 children, according to the health ministry, whose figures do not differentiate between combatants and civilians.

Israeli authorities say 40 Israeli soldiers and four civilians have been killed during the conflict.

articles.title: Ex-CDS Anil Chauhan's new warning on Pakistan: Defence pacts may fuel 'overconfidence'
articles.summary: News News: Former Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan (retired) has sounded a note of caution over Pakistan's newly signed defence agreements, warning th.
articles.body: Former Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan (retired) has sounded a note of caution over Pakistan's newly signed defence agreements, warning they could breed "some kind of overconfidence" in Islamabad and risk pushing it toward "some kind of miscalculation again."Speaking at the 22nd GB Pant Memorial Lecture on the theme of threats and challenges to India's security, Chauhan flagged the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed on August 7 between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye, under which an attack on any one nation is treated as an attack on all three.The pact follows an earlier Saudi-Pakistan Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement signed last September, and the former CDS made clear India needs to watch this evolving alignment closely.Pakistan, he said, would remain "a major issue of concern" going forward, with terrorism and proxy war continuing to sit at the core of its strategy. He described Islamabad's nuclear arsenal as having created a curious paradox, static stability at the strategic level, but greater instability lower down, as Islamabad works to shrink the space for conventional military operations while expanding sub-conventional warfare through cross-border terrorism."Pakistan will remain, I think, a major security concern trying to come. The existing nuclear weapons have created a view of static stability at the highest level, and this is what has induced instability at the lowest level. Classically known as the stability paradox," he said.Even when individual terror networks are dismantled, Chauhan warned, the broader ecosystem sustaining them, ideology, recruitment, financing, training and state support. These systems simply gets rebuilt, meaning the challenge persists regardless of the tactical successes.As per General Chauhan the answer to this predicament is credible, demonstrated deterrence. Citing the surgical strikes, the Balakot air strikes and Operation Sindoor as proof points, the former CDS argued deterrence must operate across the full spectrum, and that India needs to keep raising the cost of proxy war for Pakistan, including through measures such as keeping the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance, until it forces a real behavioural shift. That move followed last year's Pahalgam attack, though the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague recently ruled the treaty remains fully in force, a verdict India, which did not participate in the proceedings, has rejected as null and void.On the China aspect, Chauhan described the challenge as fundamentally different, "more long-term and comprehensive" than Pakistan's, rooted in an unresolved boundary dispute where the two sides don't even share a mutually agreed definition of the Line of Actual Control. Differences in perception, combined with infrastructure build-up and growing capabilities on both sides, create real potential for friction, he said, pointing implicitly to China's breach of prior agreements during the 2020 Eastern Ladakh stand-off. Even so, Chauhan insisted India's relationship with Beijing cannot be reduced to boundary issues alone, since the two nations cooperate in some spheres even as they compete for influence elsewhere, a balance he said will substantially shape the future of Asia.

articles.title: Fuel prices at record Labor Day high in U.S. due to Iran war and refinery issues
articles.summary: It’s never been more expensive in the U.S. to fill up the tank and take one last summer trip over the Labor Day weekend.
articles.body: It’s never been more expensive in the U.S. to fill up the tank and take one last summer trip over the Labor Day weekend. The average price of regular gas was $4.14 a gallon heading into the holiday, nearly a dollar higher than last year and well above the Labor Day weekend record of $3.82 from 2012, according to AAA motor club. Nicole Collins planned to head from Philadelphia to South Carolina to visit friends, but she said her family has spent most of the summer close to home and not taking their typical weekend trips because driving has gotten so expensive. “Gas is pretty high right now. It doesn’t help that we also have a baby, so we also have to pay for that,” Collins said outside a gas station in Claymont, Delaware, where regular gas was $4.199 a gallon. Prices shot up after the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran in February and have not settled down since. Crude oil traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz has plunged, and Iran has refused to reopen the waterway. “Everything points to the Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz,” said Tom Seng, a professor of energy finance at Texas Christian University. Energy Secretary Chris Wright offered few specifics on when the nation’s drivers might see relief at the gas pump, acknowledging that prices are higher now than Labor Day 2025. “Yes, they’re higher today, but we’re doing everything we can to push them down,” Wright said Sunday on ABC’s “This Week.” The national average for regular gas prices is still well below the record of $5.02 a gallon set in June 2022. But diesel is a different story: It hit a national average of $5.85 a gallon Friday, a record. Trucks and other freight delivery systems use a lot of diesel, and that increased transportation cost is being passed on to consumers, whether at the grocery store or through package delivery services. “It doesn’t really seem like there’s an end to it,” Collins said. Gas prices typically drop as the summer driving season ends and refineries turn to making a cheaper winter blend. But Seng said there are other factors this year even beyond the volatile situation in the Middle East that make future prices unpredictable. U.S. refineries are working at 98% capacity, many in the unusually harsh Texas heat. If there are problems there or a hurricane knocks some systems offline, prices will struggle to drop. And it’s not just a Middle East problem. Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries are squeezing diesel supplies. Chinese refiners are seeing declining outputs as well, said Matthew Metzgar, a clinical professor of economics at UNC Charlotte. “There’s just less gasoline coming out of those refineries,” Metzgar said. Wright, the energy secretary, said the Trump administration was taking steps to increase production and that the markets forecast lower prices in the coming months. “If you look at the futures prices, if you wanted to buy today in bulk gasoline for two months out in November, it’s about $0.35 cheaper than it is today. So the marketplace thinks gasoline prices are going to move meaningfully lower,” he said. Geopolitically, though, there is little a driver can do to knock down gas prices. But using price apps can help save a little money, especially on long trips where gas by the interstate could be 10 to 15 cents per gallon more expensive than at stations a short drive down the road, Metzgar said.
